# Public course calendar fixtures

Minimized snapshots from the official University of Washington CSE Autumn 2026
course sites, downloaded October 20, 2026. Original source URLs are recorded in
`manifest.json`.

These files retain the page identity, navigation, dates, assignments, and material
links needed to exercise the importer. Unrelated biographies, styling, and
office-hour blocks have been removed. The CSE 311 configuration is read as text;
the importer does not execute downloaded JavaScript.

Fixtures are used only by regression tests. They never populate a new workspace.
Course content belongs to its respective authors; these snapshots are included
solely to make calendar-parser tests repeatable.
